facts.fact: Cedsif, IP (Centre for Development of Information Systems in Finance) has a Secondary Data Center with UPS batteries already installed, supporting its critical financial information systems; the document (2026-07-24) is a tender for a battery-supply facility there, and names neither the secondary site's place nor the main site's (place not stated, main site place not stated).

note: The tendered UPS battery facility is backup power, class other; only the existing secondary data center is recorded, place not stated.
